notes.title: Update and DLCs
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]:

Rephrased some of the questions to reduce ambiguity.
Added English retranslation supported by Splashman, DracoGideon, Clarste, from Reality Dreamers and [url=https://www.thpatch.net/wiki/Touhou_Patch_Center]Touhou Patch Center[/url].ality Dreamers)
Now support the 2 new DLCs.

[h1] 2 DLCs are available now[/h1]:
Added 2 DLCs, each featuring 50 new questions.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/916360
https://store.steampowered.com/app/916361
Currently, you may only play the extra 100 quetions or all 250 questions as a whole once you had the DLCs installed.
